Usage: pty metadata patch --id <stable-id>
       pty metadata cas --id <stable-id>

Mutate metadata for one exact stable session id without resolving display-name
aliases. `patch` atomically merges presentation fields. `cas` reads one JSON
request and compares one tag under the registry lock, fenced by generation.

Patch fields:
  displayName   string to set, null to clear, omitted to preserve
  tags          object of string values to set and null values to remove

CAS request:
  expectedGeneration   exact opaque session generation
  tag                  non-empty tag key
  expectedValue        value that must still be current
  value                replacement value

Examples:
  pty metadata patch --id a1b2c3d4 < patch.json
  printf '%s' '{"displayName":"Worker","tags":{"role":"worker"}}' | pty metadata patch --id a1b2c3d4
  printf '%s' '{"expectedGeneration":"7f44b35e","tag":"run.url","expectedValue":"https://old.example","value":"http://127.0.0.1:4321"}' | pty metadata cas --id a1b2c3d4
